title: Synergy of strength–ductility in HfMoTaTiZr refractory high entropy alloy through Cr addition

recollection.intervention: Addition of chromium (Cr) to the alloy
recollection.structure: Likely a modified high entropy alloy with potential phase changes or microstructural adjustments due to Cr addition
recollection.mechanism: Possibly Cr addition alters the lattice structure or phase stability, enhancing mechanical properties
recollection.results: Likely improved synergy between strength and ductility, with quantitative measures of mechanical properties such as yield strength and elongation

score.note: The recollection identifies Cr addition, but only at the level stated in the title and omits the 4.2 at.% amount and processing method. It does not identify the reticulated multicomponent Laves phase. The proposed mechanism is generic and misses solid-solution hardening, increased dislocation density, and crack hindrance/plasticity compensation by the Laves network. No quantitative results are recalled.
